visual_review: Side-view crow pose: head forward and low, straight arms planted on a floor line, rounded back rising to the hips and folding into the thigh on the arm, shins level behind. The floor and the shins make it a balancing figure rather than a letter R.
omissions: Reference's outlined tube body drawn as single strokes (8-wide tubes leave no room for the inner leg line).
